name: Anzus
cooked: Nice to see this open-sourced. One question from the user side: if the coordinator server goes offline or stops being maintained, can co-signers still recover and spend with just their hardware wallets? And does the app prompt everyone to save a backup of the wallet setup when the wallet is first created?
